paragraphs.text: New Argive is the largest and most notable of the Terisian Isles on Dominaria .

New Argive is bordered by the Videnthian Sea in the northeast , the Visceral Sea in the east, the Shattered Sea in the southeast, the Shielded Sea in the southwest, , and the Sea of Laments in the west.

Treva , the Renewer is the primeval dragon of New Argive. New Argive is home to two nations of dragons. Alabaster Dragons are serene and wise and can be seen soaring at high altitudes among the clouds. They rarely touch the ground, spending weeks aloft. The dragons of Kher Ridges are destructive predators ruled by the hellkite Prossh .

New Argive's chief nation is the eponymous New Argive, a diverse nation of immigrants inhabited by Humans , Dwarves , Kor , Orcs , and Aven . A nation of archaeologists and historians, it is considered a major seat of learning, and its universities and museums are unrivaled within the Terisian Isles .

The nation of New Argive was formed in 2954 AR by Balduvia and Kjeldor after the end of Dominaria's Ice Age , in the first few years of the Thaw . The modern nation is considered to have been built over the ruins of ancient Argive , which was itself built over the ruins of the Thran Empire .
In 3224 AR, the Sheoltun Occupation happened, and New Argive was conquered by the Sheoltun Empire based out of Benfosa (modern-day Benalia ).

In 3274 AR, the uprising in Epityr was the straw that broke the Sheoltuns' back, and the already fading empire soon after lost all control of eastern Terisiare. The Argivians were able to push the Sheoltun out with the aid the songmage Thabit and his summoned Serra Angels . Serranism remains a popular religion in New Argive.

In 3307 AR, Karn arrived somewhere in New Argive in conjunction with one of Urza 's and Barrin 's time travel experiments. There, Karn witnessed the aftermath of a grueling battle with many dead humans . He found a shield, a New Argivian bracer, indicating that one side of the battle was the defenders of the New Argivian nation. Who the New Argivians were fighting against at this point is unknown, but Sheoltun stragglers or counter-insurgents seem likely.
New Argive was devastated during the second phase of the Phyrexian Invasion but recovered. However, the country had to deal with an infiltration by Cabal agents.

In the lead-up to the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , New Argive was considered the most powerful armed force on the continent of Terisiare . King Darien XLVIII put the nobleman Stenn in charge of discovering Phyrexian sleeper agents . However, as Stenn was one himself, he used the position to infect Argivia with Phyrexians.
Adarkar Wastes - flat barrens on the western coast
Argivia - capital of New Argive New Argive's watchtower
Bak-Fal - a coastal city built atop an enormous Thran construct that can carry the city to safety in the event of a tsunami.

Balduvian Steppe - large, open plains northwest of the Karplusan Mountains. The Flarg - a mountainous region, formerly home to goblins. The ruins of Kor Haven (originally on Rath ) Lake Balduvia - a lake in southern Balduvia, close to the Karplusans.
Cade - a small village
Growlers' Point - the site of a collapsed lighthouse.
The Isles of Argive - an island chain northeast of the mainland.

The Karplusan Mountains - previously known as the Sardian Mountains . Balesh Pass - site of battles between orcs and humans . Calum - a city that fell to the Phyrexians during the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . Eastenlake - northeast of former Soldev Elbreth - a city that fell to the Phyrexians during the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . Epityr - an ancient settlement and center of learning. The Last Battlefield - the site where Lim-Dûl's Battle was fought. Mount Delapre - A high peak along Balesh Pass Mount Kireshal - A high peak above Balesh Pass Narmund Forest - a forest and site of a battle involving goblins Tarnrish - a place of high mountain lakes that shine a vivid blue.
The Kher Ridges - a mountainous region stretching south from the Karplusans. Kher Keep - ancient lair of Kobolds Koilos - ancient caves of Thran origin Urza's Tower - an ancient tower
Korlis - an island, last remnant of Fyndhorn
Lake Darien - a large lake named for King Darien the Great
Rivenrock - an archaeological digsite
Toribah - a city that fell to the Phyrexians during the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .
Westerbend - an archaeological digsite
A Yavimayan Colony - connected to Yavimaya by a Magnigoth mangal.
In the Dominaria United worldbuilding video, New Argive was described as having a "techno-Scandinavian feel."
